stem:
In a school project, Meera from Punjab and Arjun from Kerala bring their traditional dishes. Meera brings sarson ka saag with makki ki roti, while Arjun brings rice with fish curry and coconut chutney. Which of the following options about why traditional foods differ across Indian states is incorrect ( )
A. Traditional food in a state is usually based on the crops grown in that state
B. Traditional foods also differ because of taste preferences, culture, and traditions of the people
C. All people living in a state eat exactly the same traditional food
D. Locally available crops, along with culture and traditions, shape a region's traditional food

options.text: Traditional food in a state is usually based on the crops grown in that state
Traditional foods also differ because of taste preferences, culture, and traditions of the people
All people living in a state eat exactly the same traditional food
Locally available crops, along with culture and traditions, shape a region's traditional food

teacher.key_rationale: Statement C is incorrect because people within a state do not all eat the same traditional food; food choice varies with locally grown crops, taste preferences, culture, and traditions. A, B, and D correctly state these factors. The source's 'identify the incorrect statement' structure and four-option single-MCQ format are preserved, retargeted onto the traditional-foods decision with an Indian school setting and Indian names.
